description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which is part of a logging system. It specifies a contract for classes that handle logging output, allowing chaining of multiple log handlers and potential filtering.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component that outputs logs and can be chained with other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output log data, including log level, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exceptions.
